content.short: Summon Platform is a comprehensive solution for DAO creation, on-chain voting, and governance & treasury management.
content.description: Summon Platform is the premier DAO creation and governance platform on the Cardano blockchain. Stemming from the team members and efforts of ADAO, and the principles forged while developing several open-sourced tools and dApps, Summon seeks to enable the Cardano Ecosystem to create and manage their own DAOs, staking portals, smart contracts, governance modals, tokens, treasuries, and proposals, all while bolstered with Summons custom-made decentralized finance yield strategies.
